title: Outlook for Mac and iPad: pop out Copilot Chat into a floating window
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's floating-window change and distinguishes it from existing Copilot Chat capabilities. Its licensing, account-protection statement and Integrated Apps blocking path are supported, and it explicitly reports Microsoft's conflicting guidance on Teams and user scoping. Targeted searches found no documented pop-out-specific switch or release-build requirement.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a window-layout change and does not describe changes to Chat's capabilities.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window.

claims.claim: The roadmap record gives no administrator setting for the pop-out.
claims.quote: When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window. (The complete record specifies no administrator setting.)

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe this Outlook Mac and iPad pop-out at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "pop-out" "Copilot"; "568368"; Outlook Mac iPad Copilot Chat pop-out floating window. Opened Copilot overview, Manage Copilot Chat and release notes; searched the complete release notes for pop-out, floating and 568368; no matching feature.

claims.claim: No administrator action specific to the pop-out is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook Mac iPad Copilot Chat pop-out floating window policy disable; Copilot Chat Outlook pop-out disable admin setting. Opened Manage Copilot Chat, Integrated Apps and release notes; no pop-out-specific administrator action.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The pop-out is user-opt-in: users choose to click its button, with no documented pop-out administrator enablement switch.
claims.quote: When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window. Searched: Outlook Copilot Chat pop-out disable admin setting; read Manage Copilot Chat and Integrated Apps; no pop-out enablement switch.

claims.claim: No source states that existing behaviour changes for users who do not choose the pop-out.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "pop-out" "Copilot"; "568368". Read the roadmap description, Manage Copilot Chat and release notes; the roadmap describes clicking a button and retaining the in-window experience, with no contrary existing-behaviour statement found.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: The Copilot app already provides Copilot Chat in Outlook across web, desktop and mobile.
claims.quote: The Copilot app is an integrated app that provides Copilot Chat via web, in the Microsoft Copilot app (web, desktop, mobile) and in Outlook (web, desktop, mobile).

claims.claim: Copilot Chat in Outlook can work with content the user has open.
claims.quote: Use Copilot Chat in select Microsoft 365 apps like Teams and Outlook with content you have open. In this context, Copilot Chat is aware of your open content and can use it instead of requiring you to copy and paste information or upload a file.

claims.claim: Copilot Chat has Enterprise Data Protection when users sign in with Microsoft Entra accounts.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat (Basic), Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) are protected by Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) when you sign in with Microsoft Entra accounts.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The block path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Block app.
claims.quote: Sign into Microsoft 365 admin center as a Global Administrator. Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps. Select the Available Apps list. Select an app from the Available Apps list to open the overview pane. Select Block app.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps page says these controls require Global Administrator.
claims.quote: The following controls on the integrated apps portal in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center are only available to Global Admins.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app through Integrated Apps removes Copilot Chat from Outlook, rather than targeting only the pop-out.
claims.quote: If you block the Copilot app using the Integrated app control, you block the Copilot app tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook, and the web, including for users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps instructions say Block app blocks all users in the organisation.
claims.quote: When you choose to block an app, it is blocked for all users in your organization. Blocking an app overrides any previous admin deployment or user installation in Microsoft 365 and Outlook so that no one in your organization can use the app.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps page says its block affects the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook while Teams retains its Teams admin center settings.
claims.quote: The app is only be blocked in the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook. Teams continues to honor the current setting for Teams Apps made in the Teams admin center

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat, in contrast, says the Integrated Apps block includes Teams.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat describes the Integrated Apps block as tenant-wide but scopable to users or groups.
claims.quote: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps availability instructions separately document user or group selection under Edit Users or the Users tab.
claims.quote: Scroll down and select Edit Users or select the Users tab in the overview pane. ... Specific users/group in the organization can install means that only the users selected by you are able to install the app on their own from the store and use it in the client.

claims.claim: The Copilot app settings in Integrated Apps apply to both Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: On the Integrated Apps page, the CoPilot app settings apply to both Microsoft Copilot and the Copilot Chat apps. Any changes made to this app from the integrated apps portal apply to both.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent for the Integrated Apps Copilot Chat availability block is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Integrated Apps block app Outlook Copilot availability API PowerShell; "copilotPackage" "Copilot app". Read Integrated Apps, Manage Copilot Chat, Disable-App excerpt, copilotPackage:block and resource type; no mapping to the Copilot Chat app block.
